external_sources.extraction_status: Exact PDF opened through web; downloaded bytes SHA-256 checked; pdftotext extraction read; page 5 rendered and visually checked because Eq. (12) has a units inconsistency.
external_sources.translation: Source Kpoly is gamma/2, not the project's K=4piG. Source kappa is a quartic coupling kappa4, not the project's fitted kappa=1/2. Source natural-unit boson m maps to rest energy E=m_SI c^2.
external_sources.source_result_status: Verified within its nonrelativistic condensate and leading interaction approximation. The source does not derive canonical S2.
external_sources.application_status: Conditional: contact energy generates (div P)^2 when delta rho=div P; equality with the canonical full vector gradient requires curl-free P and suitable boundaries. The amplitude kappa4/m^4 remains independent.
external_sources.source_correction: Eq. (12) prints hbar^3 c^3 in a fourth root equated to mc^2. Dimensions require c^7 when G is SI. Natural-unit Eqs. (2),(3),(10) give E^4=27 hbar^3 c^7 kappa4/(4piG rc^2), which reproduces the source's rounded 10.7 eV at rc=1 kpc. Report uses this independently restored formula, not the printed c power.

external_sources.translation: Source growth rate squared is 4piG rho - hbar^2 k^4/(4m^2); oscillation omega^2 has the opposite sign. Source rJ=2pi/kJ. Our ellJ=1/kJ, so every reported ellJ is source rJ/(2pi).
external_sources.source_result_status: Verified under Newtonian nonrelativistic, self-gravitating scalar assumptions, on times short compared with cosmic expansion.
external_sources.application_status: Inapplicable as a direct canonical stiffness identification: quantum density gradients give k^4 in longitudinal P, not k^2. Conditional comparison scales are computed without claiming S2 equivalence.

search_scope: Bounded mechanism verification, not a novelty search or comprehensive literature review. Primary-source lookup used arXiv and a backward reference from Hu et al. to Goodman. No observational viability from either historical paper is imported.
